verdict.rationale: First-party docs show plugins are managed through the official Codex CLI: a `codex plugin marketplace add` subcommand, plus in-session `/plugins` and `/skills` commands for browsing, installing and invoking. Coverage is thin, though. Only a few one-line mentions exist, with no command reference or scripting/automation guidance, and the only hands-on install used third-party `npx skills` tooling rather than the official CLI. missing for 10: a full CLI command reference for plugin install/list/remove, non-interactive or scriptable usage documentation, hands-on or independent corroboration of the official CLI plugin commands.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: Use `codex plugin marketplace add` to add and track a marketplace source instead of editing `config.toml` by hand.
In Codex CLI, enter `/plugins` to open the plugin browser. Install a plugin from a configured marketplace, then start a new session before using its bundled skills or tools.
In Codex CLI or the IDE extension, run `/skills` or type `$` to mention a skill.
